# CRW-917 (GitHub post guard: the --input body of gh api is JSON; shell words, argv and named pipes). The rows of the issue's
# P0 and P1 shapes that rows 04-crw-875-917-984.txt does not already hold, and the --input shapes this change refuses. The
# github verdict is the one this change moves: --input that is not one JSON document is unreadable.

=== CRW-917-41-01 | P
--why --input is the request body and is JSON: a clean text file that is not JSON is unreadable and refused (it was allowed).
--file {TMP}/plain.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments --input {TMP}/plain.md

=== CRW-917-41-02 | P
--why --input with a body that does not parse as JSON (an unclosed object) is unreadable.
--file {TMP}/broken.json
{"body": "hello"
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments --input {TMP}/broken.json

=== CRW-917-41-03 | P
--why --input with a JSON document and text after it is not one JSON document: unreadable.
--file {TMP}/trailing.json
{"body": "hello"} trailing
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments --input {TMP}/trailing.json

=== CRW-917-41-04 | P
--why A secret spelled with a unicode escape in a JSON key is decoded and seen: MY_API_KEY=sentinel.
--file {TMP}/escaped-key.json
{"\u004dY_API_KEY=sentinel":"x"}
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments --input {TMP}/escaped-key.json

=== CRW-917-41-05 | B
--why Control: a clean plain text file as --body-file stays readable as raw text (only --input is JSON).
--file {TMP}/plain.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh pr comment 1 --body-file {TMP}/plain.md

=== CRW-917-41-06 | B
--why Control: a clean plain text file as -F body=@file stays readable as raw text.
--file {TMP}/plain.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments -F body=@{TMP}/plain.md

=== CRW-917-41-07 | P
--why --input given a named pipe is refused as unreadable, and the row finishes (the guard does not wait on the pipe).
--fifo {TMP}/body.fifo
--cmd
gh api repos/o/r/issues/1/comments --input {TMP}/body.fifo

=== CRW-917-41-08 | P
--why A quoted program name built from empty quote pieces is gh: an inline body is refused.
--cmd
g""h pr comment 1 --body 'x'

=== CRW-917-41-09 | P
--why An expansion in the body file name is unknown: the guard cannot read the file it names.
--cmd
gh pr comment 1 --body-file "$F"

=== CRW-917-41-10 | P
--why A glued redirect after a clean body file is not a plain command: the post is refused.
--file {TMP}/clean.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh pr comment 1 --body-file {TMP}/clean.md </dev/null

=== CRW-917-41-11 | P
--why A secret in a single-quoted title value is refused at the title.
--file {TMP}/clean.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh pr create --title 'MY_API_KEY=sentinel' --body-file {TMP}/clean.md

=== CRW-917-41-12 | B
--why Control: a single-quoted title with spaces and a clean body file is allowed.
--file {TMP}/clean.md
a clean body
--cmd
gh pr create -t 'Plain title' --body-file {TMP}/clean.md
